question: Which Indian state has launched Abua Awas Yojana 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jharkhand**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Abua Awas Yojana 2023 is a housing scheme launched by the state government of **Jharkhand**.
 
• The scheme aims to provide **affordable housing** to the economically weaker sections of the society in Jharkhand.
 
• It focuses on ensuring that every family in Jharkhand has a **permanent and secure home**.
 
• The government of Jharkhand has allocated significant funds to implement this scheme successfully.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY)**

 
 
• It is a flagship housing scheme of the Government of India launched in 2015.
 
• The scheme aims to provide affordable housing to the urban poor by the year 2022.
 
• It has two components: **PMAY-U** (Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban) and **PMAY-G** (Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin).
 
• The scheme intends to build 20 million affordable houses by 31 March 2022.
 
 
 
• **Rajiv Awas Yojana (RAY)**
 
 
• This was an Indian government scheme aimed at promoting a slum-free India.
 
• It was launched in 2011 with a focus on providing housing and basic amenities to slum dwellers.
 
• The scheme also aimed to prevent the growth of slums in the future.
 
 
 
• **Indira Awas Yojana (IAY)**
 
 
• This was a social welfare program launched by the Government of India to provide housing for the rural poor in India.
 
• It was initiated in 1985 by the then Prime Minister Rajiv Gandhi.
 
• The scheme was renamed as **Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)** in 2016.
 
• It aims to provide "Housing for All" by 2022.
